name: whisper-transcriber
title: Whisper Transcriber
description: Transcribe local audio and video files with OpenAI Whisper.
author: alex_valdez

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Whisper Model
preferences.description: Choose the Whisper model to use for new transcriptions.

preferences.name: outputMode
preferences.title: Output Location
preferences.description: Choose where TXT transcripts should be saved.

preferences.name: outputDirectory
preferences.title: Custom Output Directory
preferences.description: Choose the folder to use when Output Location is set to Custom Output Directory.

preferences.name: whisperPath
preferences.title: Whisper CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional path to the whisper CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-detect it.

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: FFmpeg Path
preferences.description: Optional path to the ffmpeg binary. Leave empty to auto-detect it.

commands.name: transcribe
commands.title: Transcribe File
commands.subtitle: Whisper
commands.description: Transcribe a local audio or video file with Whisper.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
